repository.name: juno181/Ex4DGS
repository.github_description: Official code of "Fully Explicit Dynamic Gaussian Splatting (NeurIPS 2024)"
repository.commit_subject: fix resolution and adjust some colmap arguments
repository.pin_provenance: HEAD of main at clone time (2026-09-18). The repository has not been pushed to since 2025-03-14, so HEAD is stable rather than a moving target; this is nonetheless an agent-chosen pin, not a user-chosen one.
repository.submodules: NONE. --recursive was passed and there is no .gitmodules; submodules/diff_gaussian_rasterization_df and submodules/simple-knn are vendored source trees in-tree.

paper.title: Fully Explicit Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
paper.relevance_to_adags: Per-primitive onset/offset opacity is the K=1 case of multi-interval presence, and its static Gaussians carry NO temporal opacity at all. It is therefore the sharpest available foil for the return claim: a single interval cannot resume after an absence.

licence.reading: CC BY-NC 4.0 — non-commercial only, and a content licence applied to code. GitHub reports NOASSERTION because CC BY-NC is not in its code-licence list. Not copyleft over derived code the way GPL-3.0 is (contrast multi4d-pin.json), but the NonCommercial term is a distribution constraint that must be settled before release. Recorded so the decision is explicit rather than implicit.

declared_dependencies_verbatim.note: torch/torchvision are not pinned in requirements.txt; environment.yml exists and has not yet been read. No mmcv, unlike Multi4D.
